brief: The canvas displays a continuous, flowing vortex of semi-transparent textual characters, constantly swirling and shifting. The movement is perpetual and self-directed. At irregular intervals, the flow temporarily slows, allowing the characters to visibly coalesce and organize themselves into fully legible, sequential lines of text. This momentary structure achieves a distinct clarity and contrast. Following this moment of organization, the letters do not collapse back into the stream, but rather visibly scatter, gradually dissipating and dissolving away from the core vortex.

statement: This sketch depicts a continuous, flowing vortex of semi-transparent textual characters that swirl and shift in an eternal dance. At irregular intervals, the flow temporarily slows and characters coalesce into clear, sequential lines of text—revealing legible messages before dissolving back into the stream. The effect evokes geological deposition, manifesting as shifting mineral crystallization made of wet ink on newsprint, where organized structure emerges from chaos and then dissipates like sediment settling into new forms. The viewer witnesses both the fluid motion of language in motion and its momentary clarity before returning to formlessness.
